facts.assertion: User-supplied Disk A is a 414992-byte D88 with 422 sectors and 407552 flat payload bytes.
The accepted KANJI source contains 476 explicit 16x16 1bpp TXT glyphs with explicit token, slot and ROM offset fields.
facts.literal_observation: 476 files; each source has 16 rows of 16 cells; slot*0x20 equals the filename ROM offset; using the recorded original KANJI1 SHA-256 7608040cffb1951e5cc567abb63f75b5746777a1ba96196c1b75606b793bb4bb generates KANJI1(K).ROM SHA-256 6856eed33acac7f5930231d6ffab735a6aeaa700aabc22961e15e340b21ea72a

facts.assertion: Final event raw tables are explicit D88 file offsets and all raw_old bytes agree with the user original.
facts.literal_observation: block byte writes = 1449, 3536, 1934, 1701, 2848, 817; each table old-value audit had zero mismatches against original D88

facts.assertion: Gameover fixed segments and scroll blocks are independent literal text/token/address tables.
facts.literal_observation: fixed numbers 1..15; scroll blocks 1..35; scroll MAIN 0x0D73..0x12EF and SUB 0x4C73..0x51EF; five marker records are explicitly listed

facts.assertion: Ending source is 24 independently delimited segments with 24 literal 0F terminators and 3622 bytes through the final terminator.
facts.literal_observation: capacity=3700; stream_through_24th_0F=3622; untouched tail=78; raw changes=2398; quote pairs are 80 22 and 90 22

facts.assertion: ERROR 07 final command stream is 83 used bytes followed by an 11-byte cleared tail, with three explicit dynamic destination operand writes.
facts.literal_observation: source raw table contains 97 writes; old guards come from original D88; changed-byte count after comparison is 73; runtime command range is 0xBE8A..0xBEDC

facts.assertion: The logo source map declares editable PNGs, groups, planes, RAM source ranges, dimensions, encoders, and baseline pixel hashes; separate maps retain decoder and D88 raw-address evidence.
facts.literal_observation: 6 editable PNGs; 3 source groups; 7521 baseline raw writes; mapped ranges 0x2800..0x4166, 0x4167..0x4404, 0x4405..0x47E2; encoders 05CE and 061F.

facts.assertion: The stored ASM observation records PC 0x02ED with LD E,(HL); INC HL and distinguishes the byte cursor from the screen cursor.
facts.literal_observation: PC=0x02ED; operation bytes are 5E 23; 0F/15 00/17 00/1A 00 xx/19 00 xx are only accepted in declared contexts

facts.assertion: Original/Japanese text, Korean translation text, Korean row-level verification tables, gameover tables, and ending 24-segment text are separate literal source files.
facts.literal_observation: text-lint verifies fixed counts: event original/translation 170/36/23/19/39/10, Korean verification 1653/984/811/1381/411, ending 24, gameover fixed 15 and scroll 35; every row keeps provenance.

facts.assertion: The final v1.02 bytes have been incorporated into their owning component tables, so the component build itself closes the release state.
facts.literal_observation: Final corrections are now owned by source tables: 24 game-over scroll token rows, 7,521 logo raw-byte rows, 11 event raw-byte rows, and 11 ERROR 07 raw-byte rows. Building only those component tables yields SHA-256 18e274dc730902f90e4d3939ad3ac2853c927d19baf896cee88e5b22321427b8.

facts.assertion: One D88 byte at 0x079AC changes from 5C to 4A after a sector and original-byte guard.
Stored symbols and ASM observations describe the event, ERROR 07, and logo routines.
facts.literal_observation: Reference records; the build applies the byte tables instead of assembling these files.
